description: Provider-neutral model-routing policy (ADR-0003, binding contract refined by ADR-0013). Task classes map to portable tiers; host_aliases bind tiers to host model names per provider with strictly tier keys. alias_supported=true hosts (native aliases) resolve the latest available version on the fly at runtime; alias_supported=false hosts carry concrete pins whose staleness is auditable via pinned_at. Fallback chains live in the top-level `fallbacks` namespace, never inside host_aliases. Host model names are illustrative examples — replace them with the model IDs your provider/CLI exposes at deployment time.
